replicasHint: Current replicas: {{current}}. With 0 the application stops.

restart: Kubernetes recreates the Pods one at a time following the update strategy (rolling restart).
With at least 2 replicas and readiness probes the service stays available.
With a single replica the service may be interrupted for a few seconds.
restartPod: The Pod is deleted and its controller (Deployment, StatefulSet, …) creates a new one.
Requests served by this Pod are interrupted; other replicas keep working.
restartPodUnmanaged: This Pod is NOT managed by a controller: it will be deleted and NOT recreated.
scaleUp: Free resources are needed on the nodes: if missing, new replicas stay Pending.
scaleDown: Capacity is reduced: check that the remaining replicas can handle the load.
scaleZero: All replicas are terminated: the application stops.
The service will be unavailable until it is scaled up again.
pause: Further template changes will not be applied until the rollout is resumed.
resume: Pending changes are applied with a progressive update.
rollback: The Deployment goes back to the template of revision {{revision}} with a progressive update.
A new revision is created: you can roll back again.
cordon: The node will receive no new Pods.
Pods already running on the node are NOT moved (use drain for that).
uncordon: The node becomes available for new Pods again.
suspend: Next scheduled runs will not start.
unsuspend: Scheduled runs resume according to the schedule.
trigger: A Job with the same template as the CronJob is created immediately.
delete: The resource is permanently deleted from the cluster.
delete_pods: The Pod is deleted; if managed by a controller it will be recreated.
delete_deployments: The Deployment and all its Pods are deleted: the application stops.
Services, ConfigMaps and volumes are not deleted.
delete_statefulsets: The StatefulSet and its Pods are deleted.
delete_services: The Service is deleted: clients can no longer reach the application by this name.
delete_ingresses: External access through this Ingress stops.
delete_configmaps: Pods using this ConfigMap may fail to restart.
delete_secrets: The Secret is deleted: Pods using it cannot restart.
The credentials it contains are lost unless a copy exists.
delete_persistentvolumeclaims: The volume is released: with reclaimPolicy Delete the DATA IS DELETED.
delete_persistentvolumes: The volume is deleted: data may be lost permanently.
delete_namespaces: ALL resources of the namespace (applications, services, configuration, volumes) are deleted.
delete_jobs: The Job and its Pods are deleted.
delete_cronjobs: The CronJob will no longer schedule runs.

downtime.restart: None with 2+ replicas and readiness probes; short with 1 replica
downtime.restartPod: Short, limited to the requests of this Pod
downtime.delete_namespaces: Total for all applications in the namespace
downtime.rollback: None with rolling update and readiness probes
